After earning their first conference win last weekend, 37-30 over Maryland, the Scarlet Knights are out in Evanston, Illinois, to take on the No.24 Northwestern Wildcats. The game will be broadcast live at 12 p.m. on Peacock. As always, let us know your thoughts and opinions about the game in the comments below!
 Betting info

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Spread: Northwestern -15.5 (was -16.5, Over/under: 58.5 points
 Weather report: Temperatures will be around 63 degrees around kickoff and rise to about 65 degrees by the game's end. Wind gusts will be up to 16 mph and no rain is expected.
